title: Remove the unused HierarchyLevelProgress.levelLabel field and its 'Level 1'/'Level 2' fallback computation
why: hierarchy_progress_card.dart (the only production consumer of HierarchyLevelProgress) reads level.level and level.levelName, never level.levelLabel — a whole-tree grep for '.levelLabel' turns up zero non-definitional reads outside this field's own computation and test call sites. The field, its threading through CurriculumProgressService's three private builder methods, and its hardcoded 'Level 1'/'Level 2' English fallback are all computed on every progress-screen load for no consumer; that fallback would itself have been an AX-2 violation had this field ever actually reached a Text widget.
recommendation: Delete HierarchyLevelProgress.levelLabel, the levelLabel/levelLabels parameters through CurriculumProgressService's builder methods, and update the ~15 test call sites that currently pass/assert it.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn '\.levelLabel\b' lib/ test/ (excluding the removed definition) returns no hits after the change; curriculum_progress_service_test.dart assertions are updated accordingly.

corrections: Recommendation cites '~15 test call sites'; exact grep for singular 'levelLabel:' colon-syntax finds 10, not 15. Cosmetic overcount, doesn't affect the verdict. Also, the acceptance-criteria grep '\.levelLabel\b' will still hit the unrelated CurriculumLabels.levelLabel( static method in curriculum_label_variant_test.dart:203 even after a correct fix — that AC needs a narrower pattern.
